purpose: Evidence for all 12 WO-0010 baseline H3 qualified-event FNs; raw image analysis is independent of GT identities.

reproduction.selection_rule: For each GT object derive strict qualification at line160/h2 and its first-visible allowed frame. Build the TP set from original trace events having a non-null ground_truth_object_id, that object in qualified_events, and event.frame_id equal to allowed_observation_frames[object_id], respecting first-event duplicate handling. Select qualified IDs absent from that strict TP set. The baseline has zero spurious and duplicate events, so this also equals the non-null event-ID set difference used in the initial extraction. This post-run audit never feeds segmentation or tracking.
reproduction.binary_reconstruction: Original Gray8 H3 PNG threshold >=128; OpenCV 8-connected components; source PNGs are independently hash-recorded.

ablation_cross_check.interpretation: Disabling the merge-width guard still reports 19 TP/12 FN; all per-event full-sequence merged-component centroid maxima are below the count exit boundary.

posthoc_track_association.note: GT identity was used only to score/label trace after inference.

full_sequence_contact_scan.parity_conclusion: Both even and odd observed frames have only zero-pixel bbox gaps and shared 8-connected labels; no rounding-induced separation alternation was observed.

missed_events.supported_cause: At every actually observable frame scanned, target and available immediate same-row neighbors have raster bbox gap 0 and share one 8-connected Binary8 component. Their touching edge columns have equal original gray values (220 or 222), with zero edge delta. This H3 row-band is width 160/area 2240 and merge-suspect; disabling the guard still leaves its measured centroid left of the count exit threshold. The nearby drops in two cases are cofactors only; visible frames around them remain merged.

aggregate_finding: All 12 misses occur in five small-target conditions. Original PNGs show an 8x14 target touching same-row neighbors at 0 raster gap, yielding one 8-connected component; the pattern is present on both even and odd observable frames. Contact columns have equal gray values 220/220 or 222/222, so no grayscale boundary marks the seam. There is no gap alternation from pixel rounding in these source files. The component is rejected as merge-suspect; without that guard, the entire row-band centroid remains before the count exit threshold. Two nearby missing frames are secondary, not the primary separation cause.
